author: dieterolson
body:
### Integration Evidence Correction

During the shot-pattern integration into main `fa7ee92f5c`, root rejected the primary worker's validation claims: its output reported pytest nodes absent from the cited checkout, including `test_checksum_receipt_generation` and `test_clean_environment_reproducibility` in `tests/research/test_shot_pattern_final_report_assets.py`, and `test_rigid_contact_determinism` in `tests/unit/physics/test_rigid_contact.py`. Inconsistent counts are not accepted as evidence. No merge was committed on that basis.

The exact worker output/report and source-bound rejection are preserved in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/phase2/validation/main_integration_candidate_v1/` (commit `b775c3988b`). Root independently executed the actual bounded suites: 282 passed, no failures/errors/skips (provider 86, scoring 25, GUI 43, report 47, contact/physics 81). Actual command output, JUnit, before/after source hashes and provider/native identities are preserved in `validation/main_integration_independent_runtime_v1/` (commit `595ef80a48`). These replace the rejected test claims; they do not qualify final publication or empirical accuracy.

Astra independently verified canonical registry preservation and generation/governance checks. The stale launcher boundary was separately reviewed with 71 passing tests, then its exact fingerprint was rechecked before recording the review and regenerating context; check/evaluate pass. Evidence is in `validation/main_integration_metadata_qualification_v1/` (commit `6bd6eae68a`). Historical execution receipts remain unchanged.

One repository-policy defect remains under repair: the inherited root handoff is 1,025 lines against the 150-line limit. A concise index with byte-preserved peer records is being prepared and will receive independent review. Integration remains uncommitted pending that review and remaining delivery gates. Leave this issue open until merged acceptance; no issue closure is requested.
